verdict.rationale: Build and type-check scaling is a fair question for a UI framework, but the evidence pack has nothing on how SolidJS compile or TypeScript check times behave in multi-thousand-component codebases or monorepos. The TypeScript/Vite integration claim (solid-gh-15) is adjacent tooling, and the 'largish web product' praise speaks to runtime reactivity, not build performance. Neither counts toward this story.
